description: Astriva — “a story behind the sky.” A creative team building interactive websites and digital stories through AI, design, web development, and innovation.
summary:
ASTRIVA🪐
Not All Worlds Are Found. Some Are Written.

ASTRIVA is an AI-assisted, bilingual (English & Urdu) interactive digital storytelling platform that introduces children to human-made artifacts left behind on the Moon and Mars.

Through an interactive digital book, AI-powered chatbot, first-person voice narration, historical timelines, and AI-generated animations, children can discover each artifact's history, purpose, and journey through space.

🎟️ The platform also features Send a Message to Space, where children can submit fictional messages and receive personalized digital space tickets.

 🌟 OUR MISSION
To make space education interactive, accessible, and enjoyable through storytelling and AI technology.
details: ASTRIVA🪐 Interactive Space Storytelling Platform | NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 🌌 PROJECT OVERVIEW ASTRIVA is an interactive digital storytelling platform that introduces children to the history of space exploration through human-made artifacts left behind on the Moon and Mars. It transforms scientific information into an engaging digital book, allowing children to explore artifacts, discover their purposes, and learn about the missions behind them. 📖 01 | INTERACTIVE DIGITAL BOOK - A digital book featuring a collection of space artifacts. - Dedicated sections covering each artifact's creation, purpose, mission, journey, and historical significance. 🤖 02 | AI-POWERED CHATBOT - An integrated AI chatbot serving as a virtual learning companion. - Provides interesting facts and additional information about selected artifacts. - Encourages curiosity and further exploration. 🎙️ 03 | FIRST-PERSON STORYTELLING - Each artifact narrates its own story through voice narration. - Introduces its purpose, journey into space, and historical background. ⏳ 04 | INTERACTIVE TIMELINE - Clickable timelines for individual artifacts. - Highlights key milestones: Creation → Launch → Arrival → Mission Events. - Allows children to explore specific events and dates. 🎬 05 | AI-GENERATED ANIMATED VIDEOS - Artifact stories brought to life through animations generated using Google Flow AI. - Individual clips manually combined and edited into complete storytelling sequences. - Supports visual learning and makes scientific information easier to explore. 🌐 06 | BILINGUAL ACCESSIBILITY Available in English and Urdu: - 🇬🇧 English:For international learners. - 🇵🇰 Urdu: Making scientific concepts more accessible to Pakistani students, particularly those studying science in Urdu. 🧠 07 | AI TOOLS & DEVELOPMENT Tools incorporated into our AI-assisted development and creative workflow: - Google Cloud - Google AI Studio - Google Flow AI - Grok Used to support website development, visual and interactive elements, and animation creation. Generated video clips were subsequently combined and edited manually. 🎟️ 08 | SEND A MESSAGE TO SPACE An interactive creative activity where children can: - ✍️ Enter their names and personal messages. - 🚀 Submit their messages through ASTRIVA. - 🎫 Receive a personalized ASTRIVA Space Ticket, inspired by astronaut mission tickets. A fictional activity designed to encourage creativity and provide a memorable digital souvenir. Messages are not actually transmitted into space. --- 🌟 OUR VISION To make space education more engaging through storytelling, AI technology, and interactive learning. "Every artifact has a story, and every child deserves the opportunity to discover it."
